verification_scope.adapter_protocols: Offline injected GitHub/Codex protocols plus real subprocess argv delivery of profile instructions and Git-worktree lifecycle tests.
verification_scope.ci_controller: Real-Git trusted-policy/candidate fixtures and real check subprocesses; CI remains independent of candidate run locators.
verification_scope.codex_smoke: Installed CLI 0.162.1 version, interactive/exec/resume/debug-models help and bundled model/effort catalog observed. Coordinator launch and exact-UUID resume argv parse with --help. All 50 adapter tests pass with RDD_CODEX_SMOKE=codex. This smoke performs no inference and does not prove entitlement, actual resumption, Goals or native child isolation. Requested settings are not backend-model attestation.
verification_scope.github_actions: Hosted baseline 0f7e76f: Ubuntu, macOS and Windows candidate harness jobs passed; trusted-controller and aggregate verify jobs failed. Later candidate results belong in their exact-revision CI reports.
verification_scope.rust_and_buf_execution: Actual multi-module native/WASM generator/compiler proof suite executed with Rust 1.99.0 and Buf 1.73.0. Raw results are retained under .rdd/evidence/harness-contracts/.
verification_scope.native_cli: Observed 0.162.1 interactive launch and exact-UUID resumption in a disposable harness worktree, using CodexAdapter.native_argv. Both bounded turns executed local Python and retained the same CODEX_THREAD_ID; serialized session evidence contains the exact coordinator developer instructions. Native turn context recorded on-request approval, user reviewer, workspace-write and the requested Astra/ultra settings on both turns. Both TUI exits returned zero. No Goal was activated and no application workflow ran. These observations do not establish backend-model attestation, native child isolation or project acceptance.
